name: Hyperspeed-TS-TW
title: Hyperspeed
blurb: Retro warp jump effect with procedurally generated road and oncoming lights.
description: THREE.js 3D scene rendering a hyperspeed highway tunnel with animated cars and light effects. Supports customizable distortion, speed, camera FOV, and road parameters. Includes bloom and SMAA post-processing.
use_when: Dramatic hero sections or full-screen transitions where an immersive speed effect commands attention.
avoid_when: Performance-critical scenarios or mobile devices; this is a full 3D scene with heavy rendering.
a11y: 3D WebGL scene with no keyboard navigation or semantic content. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
